forum.title: touchgfx natively on Linux
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello,

For now, only Windows is supported for running the Designer.

We are working on a major release that will run on Linux and Mac as well as Windows.
forum.content_text:
Greetings.

I'm a Linux user, I use Windows on a smaller notebook for tools like TouchGFX, but this is quite inconvenient.

Is there any plan to release a Linux version of TouchGFX Designer?

I saw in the documentation that there's a simulator and that it can even be used with Wine; I'll test it today, but it would be really good to have a native version.

Link where I saw information about the simulator: <https://support.touchgfx.com/docs/introduction/prerequisites>

thanks
forum.author: carlosdelfino

scraped_replies.html:
Hello,

For now, only Windows is supported for running the Designer.

We are working on a major release that will run on Linux and Mac as well as Windows.
scraped_replies.author: mathiasmarkussen
